name: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders
summary: Kul Tiras forces still hold the coast in Durotar, guided by Admiral Proudmoore's Orders. Written before Daelin Proudmoore fell at Theramore, the papers describe a campaign against the Horde.

sections.title: A Legacy of Hatred
sections.body: At Tiragarde Keep, Kul Tiras forces still mean to fight. Lieutenant Benedict's garrison holds papers detailing long-term maneuvers and fortifications against the Horde. Daelin Proudmoore's offensive in Durotar was an organized campaign, planned to continue after his death. For the Horde, these papers reveal Kul Tiras operations and possible reinforcements along its borders.

sections.title: Delivery to Grommash Hold
sections.body: Horde scouts carry the recovered orders to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. They bring them to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber. The plans support Nazgrel's warning that humans cannot be trusted and remain an active danger. Horde leaders now have reason to prepare for more attacks along the coast.

faq.answer: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders are military directives Daelin Proudmoore drew up before he fell at Theramore. They direct the remaining Kul Tiras soldiers in Durotar to fortify coastal positions and wage war against the Horde.

aliases: where do i find the orders
faq.answer: The orders were recovered at Tiragarde Keep in Durotar, during the struggle against Kul Tiras forces near the southeastern coast.

faq.q: Who needs to see these orders?
aliases: who do i turn this into
faq.answer: Nazgrel needs to see the orders. He counsels Warchief Thrall inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

faq.q: Why are Kul Tiras soldiers still fighting in Durotar?
faq.answer: Kul Tiras soldiers remain in Durotar because Lieutenant Benedict and others stayed devoted to Admiral Proudmoore's mission to exterminate the orcs. His orders gave the garrison plans to keep harassing Durotar without his direct oversight.

angles.text: For the Horde, these papers support those who argued that human truces would not last. They show Kul Tiras forces intended a war of extermination from the moment they landed.
As a Darkspear troll, these orders show that the human presence along the coast where your people make their home remains an immediate danger.
